props.name: autocapitalize
props.description: Forwarded to the underlying `<input>`. Defaults to `'none'` for email and password inputs.

props.name: autocomplete
props.description: Forwarded to the underlying `<input>`. Defaults to `'off'`.

props.name: autocorrect
props.description: Forwarded to the underlying `<input>`. Defaults to `'off'` for email and password inputs.

props.name: autofocus
props.description: Focus the input on mount (after `autofocusDelay` ms).

props.name: autofocusDelay
props.description: Delay before applying `autofocus`, in milliseconds.

props.name: avatar
props.description: When set, render `<VyAvatar>` in the leading slot instead of an icon.

props.name: avoidKeyboard
props.description:
Native keyboard avoidance (Lynx `avoid-keyboard`): the platform shifts
the whole LynxView up so the focused input clears the keyboard — exact
native window-coordinate math, no JS. Zero-setup alternative to the
`VyKeyboardAware*` family for simple forms; do NOT combine with a
`VyKeyboardAwareRoot`, the two lifts stack. Pair with
`avoidKeyboardSpacing` to also clear the field's bottom chrome.

props.name: avoidKeyboardSpacing
props.description: Extra clearance in px above the keyboard when `avoidKeyboard` is set.

props.name: confirmType
props.description:
On-screen return-key label and behavior. Maps to iOS `returnKeyType` /
Android `imeOptions`. Defaults to `'done'` from the core primitive.
Pair with `@confirm` to handle the tap.

props.name: highlight
props.description: Forces the colored ring on permanently; by default it paints while focused.

props.name: icon
props.description:
Iconify shorthand. Routed to the trailing side when `trailing` is true,
otherwise to the leading side. Explicit `leadingIcon` / `trailingIcon`
always win.

props.name: id
props.description: Forwarded to the underlying `<input>`.

props.name: leading
props.description: Force `icon` shorthand onto the leading side.

props.name: leadingIcon
props.description: Iconify name shown on the leading side (wins over `icon`).

props.name: loadingIcon
props.description: Iconify name for the spinner. Defaults to `appConfig.ui.icons.loading`.

props.name: name
props.description: Forwarded to the underlying `<input>`.

props.name: required
props.description: Forwarded to the underlying `<input>`.

props.name: trailing
props.description: Force `icon` shorthand onto the trailing side.

props.name: trailingIcon
props.description: Iconify name shown on the trailing side (wins over `icon`).

props.name: type
props.description:
Input mode — drives the on-screen software keyboard on native and the
`type` attribute on web. `'digit'` shows a pure 0-9 pad (no decimal /
sign), `'number'` shows the numeric keyboard with decimal, `'tel'` /
`'email'` give the matching layouts, `'password'` masks input.

slots.name: leading
slots.description: Receives `iconColor` so custom icons can match the input's resolved theme color.

slots.name: trailing
slots.description: Receives `iconColor` so custom icons can match the input's resolved theme color.
